title: Agora Road’s Macintosh Cafe portal
lede: The Neocities portal of a forum for vaporwave and the old internet, built as a Windows 95 desktop inside a Mac OS window.
summary: Windows 95 Control Panel and dialog inside a lavender Mac-style window, over a dim bedroom photograph.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Clear: a community site for the genre that uses its signature device, bevelled Windows 95 windows, in a lavender palette with a pixel-art figure. Its window chrome is real CSS, so it passes the shadow and radius metrics.
Partial fit: a pixel-font menu bar, pixel icons, and a dithered pixel figure, inside a vaporwave collage.

observed: A lavender menu bar with a pixel font runs across the top, with a clock at the right and pixel icons down the right edge.
A central window with a pinstriped title bar reading “Agora Road’s Macintosh Cafe” frames a teal Windows 95 desktop with Start button, taskbar, and desktop icons.
Inside, a Control Panel window and an “ANTI GLOWY CHARM” dialog with a yellow warning icon and YES and NO buttons overlap a dithered pixel-art figure holding a glowing pyramid with an eye.
Below, a bold pixel-font welcome line, a short paragraph, outlined tag chips (vaporwave, nostalgia, art, macintosh, y2k), and square buttons.
The page background is a dim, blue-tinted photograph of a bedroom.
interpretation: The measurement finds hard, unblurred shadows on 29% of boxes with a 1.4 px median offset and zero radius: the two-step Windows bevel, drawn in CSS. It finds almost no gradient or pattern, because the backdrop is a photograph.
borrow: Nest one period operating system inside another for the frame: it signals irony without any statue or sunset.

images.alt: Agora Road portal: a lavender Mac-style window containing a teal Windows 95 desktop with a Control Panel window, a warning dialog, and a pixel-art figure, above a welcome line and square buttons, on a dim bedroom photograph.
